svg.font-family: Inter, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Measured on the same machine
svg.desc: Log-scale bar chart, lower is better. Same operation, same kind of VM: a cell against a Linux process. Fork, holding 50 MiB (the fork call): Rhizo cell 1.74 µs, Linux fork() 89 µs. Fork, then the child writes all 50 MiB: Rhizo cell 8.04 ms, Linux fork + write 27.04 ms. Run hello, from start to exit: Rhizo cell 7.40 µs, Linux posix_spawn 598 µs. Resume a suspended 8 MiB program: Cell, lazy 1.30 µs, Cell, eager 598 µs, Cell, lazy + read all 630 µs, CRIU restore (host) 2.53 ms. CPython agent request, cold start: Rhizo cell 18.73 ms, Linux process 18.71 ms. CPython agent request, from a warm template: Rhizo cell 3.80 ms, Linux fork of warm 5.64 ms. Answer a Python request (MicroPython): Warm template 517 µs, Cold interpreter 3.65 ms. Whole VMs and sandboxes: a larger scope, shown for scale. Resume a whole environment: Cell, eager 598 µs, Firecracker VM 3.69 ms, gVisor sandbox 95.22 ms. Run hello in a new environment: Rhizo cell 7.40 µs, gVisor sandbox 69.46 ms.
svg.text: Time per operation, log scale (each line is 10× the previous one); lower is better
Existing mechanism, or a cold start
Same operation, same kind of VM: a cell against a Linux process
Fork, then the child writes all 50 MiB
Run hello, from start to exit
CPython agent request, from a warm template
Whole VMs and sandboxes: a larger scope, shown for scale
Run hello in a new environment
GitHub-hosted runners with KVM (shared machines, nested virtualization). Rhizo and
the Linux processes run inside Firecracker; CRIU runs on the host. Eager resume restores
every page first; lazy brings pages back on first touch.
